column1: # flow_ref 1 source=tests/spec/flow_semantics/down_chain_values.onsa tests=20 evaluated=20 unavailable=0 skipped=0 waiting=0
@ a part with a memory under down 4 counts its own ticks and the output is held between them
render down_chain_values.acc_down4 sr=0x41000000 params f=0x3f800000 frames=12
@ the output of a chain is a value of its clock: a let of that clock and a delay of it count the ticks
render down_chain_values.slow_lets sr=0x41000000 params f=0x3f800000 frames=12
@ down 2 down 2 is down 4: the inner part runs at each second tick of the outer one
render down_chain_values.acc_down2_down2 sr=0x41000000 params f=0x3f800000 frames=12
@ sample_rate of the part is 1/N of the rate of its call, one division for each boundary
@ the rate is divided at each boundary in turn, not once by the product: below the normal range they differ
@ the rate is divided from the outermost boundary in: each modifier wraps the whole on its left (§11.10)
@ a head with a stage of its own at sample / 2 of its body: that stage is of the caller at 1/4, and the frame of a tick reads the new value
render down_chain_values.head_stage sr=0x41000000 params p=0x40a00000 frames=12
@ a child with a stage of its own inside a part under down 2: a stage of the part at its place, no extra delay (S-1088)
render down_chain_values.grand_slow sr=0x41000000 params p=0x40a00000 frames=12
@ a part that is a chain itself under down 2 is down 2 down 2, and the rates are divided in turn
render down_chain_values.grand_down sr=0x41000000 params p=0x3f800000 frames=12
@ a head with a port at sample / 4 under down 2: the port is at each fourth tick of the part, the frames 0 8 ...
render down_chain_values.lag_down2 sr=0x41000000 params p=0x40a00000 frames=12
@ a chain of 1/2, a chain of 1/4 and a call with no chain side by side keep their own states
render down_chain_values.mixed sr=0x41000000 params f=0x3f800000 frames=8
@ the replicas of a par~ have a state each under down 2
render down_chain_values.par_down sr=0x41000000 params f=0x3f800000 frames=8
@ the arms of an if~ all advance under down 2, and the arms read at sample are chosen at each frame
@ a match~ arm reads its binding as the argument of a chain: the arm that is not taken binds the default and advances
@ the calls of process cut the frames anywhere, 0 frames too: the same values (§13.4)
@ a block input is read in the call of the frame of the tick, wherever the calls are cut
@ reset in the middle of a phase: the next frame is as after init
@ the panic of a part under down 4 is at its tick: the run of the frames 0 .. 3 does not stop, the call that has the frame 4 does
@ a let of the parent and a part under down 4 that both divide at the frame 4: 4 frames run, 5 stop
render down_chain_values.both_panic sr=0x41000000 params p=0 frames=4
@ S-1233: a let of the parent above the call and a part under down 4 that divide by 0 at one tick stop the run at the frame 4
render down_chain_values.both_panic sr=0x41000000 params p=0 frames=5
